faqs.question: What are the clinic timings and opening hours?
faqs.answer: We are open Monday to Saturday from 9:00 AM to 6:30 PM. We are closed on Sundays and public holidays.

faqs.question: What is the clinic address and location?
faqs.answer: We are at 2nd Floor, Lotus Medical Centre, 14 MG Road, Indiranagar, Bengaluru 560038. The nearest metro station is Indiranagar.

faqs.question: How much is the consultation fee?
faqs.answer: General physician consultations cost INR 500. Specialist consultations cost INR 800. Follow-up visits within 14 days are INR 200.

faqs.question: Which doctors are available and what are their specialties?
faqs.answer: Dr. Asha Rao is our general physician. Dr. Vikram Shah is our paediatrician. Both consult in Hindi and English.

faqs.question: How can I book an appointment online?
faqs.answer: Call this number, use the clinic website, or ask me to book for you. We need your name, phone number, preferred doctor, and a time.

faqs.question: Can I reschedule or cancel an appointment?
faqs.answer: Yes. Call us at least 4 hours before your appointment to reschedule or cancel. There is no cancellation fee.

faqs.question: Do you accept walk-ins without an appointment?
faqs.answer: Yes, walk-ins are welcome between 10:00 AM and 1:00 PM. Waiting time is usually under 30 minutes.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept, such as UPI or cards?
faqs.answer: We accept cash, all major credit and debit cards, UPI, and net banking. We do not accept cheques.

faqs.question: Is parking available at the clinic?
faqs.answer: Yes. Two-wheeler parking is free. Car parking is available in the basement for INR 30 per hour.

faqs.question: Do you offer vaccinations and flu shots?
faqs.answer: Yes. We provide childhood vaccinations, flu shots, and tetanus boosters. Please bring the vaccination card.

faqs.question: Can I get my test reports by email?
faqs.answer: Yes. Email us at reports@demo-clinic.example.com with your patient ID. Reports are sent within one working day.

faqs.question: What should I do in an emergency?
faqs.answer: Call 108 for an ambulance or go to the nearest emergency department. Do not wait for a clinic appointment.
